name: Ikkon Fujou
source:
"So, you? What's your quota for this month? How many contracts have you got? Tell me?"
"..........Zero."
"Do you take your work lightly? What are you? A god!! Right?!"

One day, Inamino Raiseki is summoned by his boss, Ogetsuhime, who is furious at Inamino Raiseki's extreme self-indulgence.

"Come on, Raiseki-chan, go on a bit of training. All the way to Ashihara no Nakatsukuni."

The god who has indulged in his self-indulgence ends up undergoing "training" in the human world as "an ordinary old man".
So the mission given to him by the local god was -

"Girls who are in the mood for sex produce these 'nasty orbs'! If you can collect six of these naughty orbs and fit them all into the treasure's hole, then it's all good! It's about sealing the orbs along with your evil thoughts! It's called 'Six Senses Purification'!"

With his divine powers confiscated, Inamino Raiseki must now take on this difficult challenge as "just an old man" - no, "just a creepy, tough old man."

Will he be able to successfully collect all six naughty orbs?
And what awaits him beyond that?
The impossible game of the corrupt old man god begins now!

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1336489]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“那么，你呢？这个月你的配额是多少？你有多少合同？告诉我？”
“……….零。”
“你把工作看得很轻吗？你是什么？神！！对吧？！”

有一天，稻野赖石被他的老板Ogetsuhime召唤，他对稻野赖石的极端自我放纵感到愤怒。

“来石酱，继续训练吧。一直到芦原中津国。”

沉迷于自我放纵的神最终以“普通老人”的身份在人间接受“训练”。
那么土神赋予他的使命就是——

“有性欲的女孩子就会产生这种‘淫珠’！如果你能收集六颗这样的‘淫珠’，将它们全部塞进宝藏洞里，那就好了！把这些‘淫珠’连同你的邪念一起封印起来！这叫‘六感净化’！”

随着神力被没收，稻野赖石现在必须以“只是一个老人”的身份接受这一艰巨的挑战——不，“只是一个令人毛骨悚然、坚强的老人”。

他能成功收集全部六个顽皮球吗？
除此之外还有什么等待着他呢？
腐败老神的不可能游戏现在开始！

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1336489]Getchu[/url]]
